description: Get calendar events. Filters: subject_contains, who_id, what_id, start_from, start_to. Dates accept YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601 datetimes. Returns: Id, Subject, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, Location, Description, WhoId, WhatId, OwnerId, IsAllDayEvent. Max 200 (default: 50).

fields.description: Custom fields (must be valid API names)

start_from.description: Events starting on/after this date or datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601; see tool description for an example)

start_to.description: Events starting on/before this date or datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601)

what_id.description: Filter by WhatId (Account or Opportunity ID)

who_id.description: Filter by WhoId (Contact or Lead ID)

name: salesforce_get_events
